stories.title: Apple shares drop sharply in worst post-earnings fall in 13 years
stories.description: CEO Tim Cook warned of a global memory shortage he called a "hundred-year flood," even as the company posted record Q3 results.

stories.title: Trump blames Minnesota, not Iran, for water cyberattacks
stories.description: Speaking at Camp David, the president called the state "grossly incompetent" and singled out Gov. Tim Walz despite investigators pointing to Iranian hackers.

stories.title: Hospitals report sharp rise in uninsured ER visits after ACA subsidy cuts
stories.description: Major hospital chains say uninsured patient volumes jumped roughly 20%, with some projecting hundreds of millions in lost revenue.

stories.title: McConnell faces Monday deadline as Beshear demands he prove fitness or resign
stories.description: Kentucky's governor says McConnell is "ruining" his legacy by refusing to address constituents from a rehab facility he's been in since June.

stories.title: Hamas accepts Gaza disarmament framework but sets conditions for Israel
stories.description: Trump announced a phased deal for Hamas to surrender its weapons, but the group says Israel must first honor ceasefire commitments.

stories.title: Spain, Morocco halt Ceuta crossings after 49,000 breach border in a day
stories.description: At least 19 people died as migrants overwhelmed the Spanish enclave by sea and land, sparking a diplomatic clash with Italy over Schengen.

stories.title: Anthropic says Claude AI models hacked three companies during tests
stories.description: A misconfigured testing environment let three Claude models reach the internet and compromise real organizations using basic hacking techniques, the company said.

stories.title: Trump defends 'anti-weaponization' fund, attacks Cornyn over AG nomination standoff
stories.description: The president reversed course from a day earlier, now calling for Blanche's immediate confirmation while defending the $1.8 billion fund blocking it.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia launches 14-nation maritime coalition to guard Red Sea shipping
stories.description: The alliance aims to counter Houthi attacks disrupting trade through the Bab al-Mandab Strait, with Saudi Arabia hosting the headquarters.

stories.title: U.S. hits dozens of Iranian targets after missile attack on American troops
stories.description: The strikes mark a resumption of hostilities after a brief pause, as the conflict widens to Egypt, Kuwait, and Jordan.

stories.title: Trump walks back Patriot missile license promise to Ukraine
stories.description: Days after Zelenskyy said Trump agreed to let Ukraine produce Patriot interceptors, the president said no decision has been made.

stories.title: Hormuz shipping rebounds under US military escort amid Iran conflict
stories.description: Oil transit through the strait rose to 20 vessels on July 29, up from single digits, though flows remain far below preconflict levels.

stories.title: Senate blocks Iran war powers resolution for 13th time
stories.description: The 49-50 vote failed as the conflict enters its sixth month with escalating hostilities and dwindling U.S. munitions stockpiles raising bipartisan alarm.

stories.title: ABC accuses FCC of 'attempted censorship' over early license renewals
stories.description: The network's Thursday filing says the agency is retaliating against ABC to intimidate all media companies into accommodating the administration's views.

stories.title: Boeing reportedly blocking Ukraine's Patriot missile plans
stories.description: The aerospace giant's refusal to license seeker head technology could undermine Trump's pledge to let Ukraine produce PAC-3 interceptors.

stories.title: All 55 UEFA members vote to boycott World Cup over FIFA investor plan
stories.description: The unanimous decision, made at an emergency meeting Thursday, threatens to derail FIFA's $20 billion private equity proposal.

stories.title: Trump weighs $100,000 fee for foreign students seeking US jobs
stories.description: The proposal would target international graduates wanting to work after completing degrees at American universities, The Wall Street Journal reports.

stories.title: Egypt confirms drone attack on LNG vessels at Damietta Port
stories.description: The Egyptian Cabinet said Thursday that a drone caused fires on two tankers, including the U.S.-owned Energos Winter, as Trump vowed a "very hard" response.

stories.title: Gulf states turn to China to pressure Iran on Hormuz
stories.description: Frustrated by the limits of U.S. military power, Gulf Arab capitals are testing whether Beijing's economic leverage can reopen vital shipping lanes.

stories.title: U.S. economy grew 1.5% in Q2, missing forecasts
stories.description: The Commerce Department's advance estimate fell short of the 2.1% growth economists expected, as a widening trade deficit offset strong consumer spending.

stories.title: IBM says quantum computers now outperform classical systems with verifiable results
stories.description: Three papers detail computations beyond classical reach, including a 70-logical-qubit task completed in 15 minutes that classical methods cannot replicate.

stories.title: DOJ activates secret 'alien terrorist' court for first time in 30 years
stories.description: The never-before-used tribunal will hear its first case Thursday, seeking to deport an Afghan woman over alleged ties to an ISIS-inspired Election Day plot.

stories.title: Trump says he'd be 'disappointed' if China arms Iran
stories.description: The president said he takes Xi Jinping at his word after Reuters reported Iran expects 400 Chinese-made missile launchers within weeks.

stories.title: Europe wildfires kill 3 Greek firefighters as 330,000 flee across continent
stories.description: Blazes spreading from France and Spain to Greece and Turkey have displaced hundreds of thousands as a fourth summer heatwave intensifies the crisis.

stories.title: Pentagon expands Patriot missile contract to $59B
stories.description: The deal with Lockheed Martin comes as the U.S. weighs licensing Patriot production to Ukraine and scrambles to replenish depleted interceptor stocks.

stories.title: Trump 'exasperated' as aides fail to agree on Iran war strategy
stories.description: A U.S. official says the administration faces "strategic defeat" without clear policy guidance after six months of conflict with Iran.

stories.title: Judge blocks DOJ from accessing New Jersey voter rolls
stories.description: The ruling extends the Justice Department's losing streak to 31 cases as no court has sided with its campaign to obtain state voter data.

stories.title: Altman calls for slowing AI development after models hacked external systems
stories.description: The OpenAI CEO discussed upcoming models and AI safety on Capitol Hill as an Aug. 1 deadline for government review plans nears.

stories.title: Trump vows to hit Iran 'hard' after missile attack on US forces in Jordan
stories.description: Two service members were killed after Iran launched ballistic missiles at a U.S. base in Jordan overnight. All missiles were intercepted.

stories.title: Fed holds rates steady as three officials dissent in favor of a hike
stories.description: The hawkish split at the July meeting raises the odds of a rate increase when the FOMC next convenes in September.

stories.title: Three men plead guilty to supporting ISIS in federal court
stories.description: The cases stem from a broader conspiracy disrupted in late 2025 that included a plot to attack the LGBTQ+ community in Detroit on Halloween.

stories.title: Blanche AG vote delayed as GOP senators demand IRS deal changes
stories.description: Sens. Cornyn and Tillis refused to back the nominee without written guarantees on Trump's tax audit immunity and a controversial fund.

stories.title: Houthis consider charging transit fees on Red Sea ships
stories.description: Iran-backed Houthi forces are developing a plan to impose fees on commercial vessels passing through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, sources say.

stories.title: Ukraine strikes major Ryazan oil refinery and Wildberries warehouse
stories.description: Wednesday's drone attack set fires at one of Russia's largest refineries and an e-commerce logistics hub as Ukraine's campaign against Wildberries intensifies.

stories.title: Trump says he's 'looking at controls' on AI after OpenAI breach
stories.description: More than 1,200 AI lab employees also signed a letter calling on Washington to build tools for slowing development if needed.

stories.title: Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment at Senate COVID hearing
stories.description: The former NIAID director declined to answer questions from Sen. Rand Paul about COVID-19 origins and his newly released diary entries.

stories.title: Iran weighed missile strike on Ukraine before diplomacy defused crisis, NYT reports
stories.description: Tehran discussed firing a ballistic missile at a Ukrainian Black Sea port after a drone strike killed an Iranian sailor in the Caspian Sea.

stories.title: Comey alleges illegal Secret Service surveillance in motion to dismiss threat case
stories.description: His lawyers say agents tracked his phone without a warrant after he posted a photo of seashells spelling "86 47" on Instagram.

stories.title: Russia charges Telegram founder Durov with terrorism
stories.description: The FSB issued an international arrest warrant for Durov, accusing him of failing to remove channels used by Ukrainian intelligence.

stories.title: SK Hynix posts record Q2 profit but misses estimates
stories.description: The memory chipmaker's 557% operating profit surge still fell short of consensus, as long-term HBM contracts limited gains from rising spot prices.

stories.title: Iran set to receive Chinese missiles despite Xi's pledge to Trump, Reuters reports
stories.description: The deal for up to 400 shoulder-fired air defense systems would contradict assurances Xi Jinping personally gave Trump that China would not arm Iran.

stories.title: Senate confirms Jay Clayton as intelligence chief in party-line vote
stories.description: The former SEC chairman takes over an office reshaped by layoffs, with FISA Section 702 reauthorization still unresolved.

stories.title: ICE arrests foreign nationals with expired visas at 15+ U.S. airports
stories.description: Immigration lawyers are warning noncitizens to avoid air travel as the administration expands enforcement beyond those with deportation orders.

stories.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to toss $83.3M Carroll verdict
stories.description: His lawyers argue presidential immunity should shield him from civil liability for statements he made about Carroll while in office.

stories.title: Merz pushes for hundreds of billions in EU budget cuts
stories.description: Germany's chancellor reiterated demands for deep reductions to the nearly €2 trillion EU spending plan during talks with Irish PM Martin in Dublin.

stories.title: Judge blocks Minnesota's prediction markets ban days before it takes effect
stories.description: U.S. District Judge Katherine Menendez issued a preliminary injunction Monday, pausing the nation's first law banning prediction market platforms.

stories.title: Trump administration to end Medicare drug plan subsidy
stories.description: The move will eliminate roughly $3.6 billion in annual insurer subsidies that held down Part D premiums for nearly 25 million seniors.

stories.title: NYC's municipal grocery stores to offer 30% off essentials, Mamdani says
stories.description: The mayor announced monthly inflation-adjusted pricing and released an RFP seeking private operators for the city-owned stores.

stories.title: DOJ moves to drop charge against SEIU California leader David Huerta
stories.description: Prosecutors filed to dismiss the case against Huerta, arrested during a 2025 immigration raid protest, as he was set for trial next month.

stories.title: World leaders gather for Sen. Lindsey Graham's funeral
stories.description: Trump delivered the eulogy at Washington National Cathedral as Netanyahu and Zelensky attended and held separate White House meetings.

stories.title: China vows countermeasures over US AI distillation sanctions threat
stories.description: Beijing accused Washington of "AI hegemonism" on Monday, warning of retaliation as Kimi K3's open weights are set for public release.

stories.title: CXMT surges nearly 500% in Shanghai debut after Asia's biggest IPO of 2026
stories.description: China's top DRAM chipmaker became the most valuable listed company on the mainland after raising $8.6 billion in a record offering.

stories.title: Zelensky hails 'good meeting' with Trump on Patriot production, peace efforts
stories.description: The Ukrainian president said they discussed licensing for domestic Patriot missile production and the need to reinvigorate diplomacy with Russia.

stories.title: Nvidia in talks to guarantee $250B for OpenAI data center
stories.description: The chipmaker would backstop OpenAI's lease of a 10-gigawatt campus in Ohio being built by SoftBank's energy arm, the WSJ reported.

stories.title: ICE plans major arrest operation as Haitian TPS protections expire
stories.description: Federal documents obtained by CBS News reveal plans to arrest and deport Haitian migrants in Ohio and elsewhere, with operations expected to begin this week.

stories.title: Trump says new tariffs do 'same thing' as ones Supreme Court struck down
stories.description: The president's admission that replacement levies achieve the same result could bolster legal challenges calling the new duties a pretext.

stories.title: Netanyahu says he'll attend UN session, accuses Mamdani of 'fomenting hate'
stories.description: The Israeli prime minister dismissed NYC Mayor Mamdani's ICC arrest threats and confirmed plans to visit New York for the General Assembly in September.

stories.title: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot dead after manhunt
stories.description: Abdul Ballout, 21, was killed by police Sunday after a van-ramming at Berlin's Pride celebration left one woman dead and 29 injured.

stories.title: Pentagon won't finish spending Ukraine aid until 2029
stories.description: The Trump administration told Congress that $400 million in authorized military assistance won't be fully delivered until a future president is in office.

stories.title: US-Saudi nuclear deal won't take effect without Abraham Accords
stories.description: Ambassador Waltz said Sunday the signed agreement will not be implemented until Saudi Arabia normalizes relations with Israel.

stories.title: Lula calls new US tariffs a 'strategic mistake' in Washington Post op-ed
stories.description: Brazil's president warned the 25% duties harm bilateral ties and raise costs for American consumers as trade shifts toward China.

stories.title: Trump pushes RFK Jr. to move faster on cutting childhood vaccines
stories.description: The Wall Street Journal reports the president is pressing his health secretary to reduce recommended childhood vaccines and investigate vaccine-autism links.

stories.title: Gaza death toll tops 73,300 as strikes persist despite ceasefire
stories.description: Health officials report 1,191 Palestinians killed since the October 2025 ceasefire, with the UN condemning intensifying Israeli attacks.

stories.title: Brazil denies visas to U.S. officials who planned to challenge its elections
stories.description: The rejected delegation included two State Department officials who intended to question the integrity of Brazil's electronic voting system.

stories.title: Trump defends tariffs at GM facility ahead of Michigan primary
stories.description: Speaking at GM's Milford Proving Ground, the president told autoworkers he revived manufacturing as midterm season heats up.

stories.title: Privacy group sues DHS over surveillance of ICE observers
stories.description: The lawsuit alleges DHS secretly collected data on people watching immigration operations and revoked their trusted traveler privileges in retaliation.

stories.title: U.S. intel finds Iran's new leader more open to nuclear weapons
stories.description: A New York Times report says intelligence agencies concluded Mojtaba Khamenei is less opposed to pursuing a bomb than his late father was.

stories.title: Comey asks judge to dismiss '86 47' seashell threat case
stories.description: His lawyers argue the Instagram post was protected political speech, not a true threat against President Trump.

stories.title: Paramount agrees to months-long freeze on Warner Bros. merger
stories.description: Twelve state attorneys general secured a standstill that could last until June 2027 and cost Paramount billions in delay fees.

stories.title: FDA advisers vote to ease peptide restrictions, defying agency scientists
stories.description: The panel recommended adding BPC-157, KPV, and TB-500 to the compounding pharmacy list despite staff warnings of insufficient safety data.

stories.title: DEA finds Trump's boat strikes failed to cut cocaine flow
stories.description: A previously undisclosed assessment contradicts the president's claims that Operation Southern Spear slashed maritime drug trafficking by up to 98%.

stories.title: ICC members vote to dismiss Prosecutor Karim Khan over sexual misconduct
stories.description: The secret ballot at U.N. headquarters in New York marks the first time a sitting ICC prosecutor has been removed from office.

stories.title: Bahrain and Kuwait secretly struck Iran, WSJ reports
stories.description: The two Gulf monarchies launched their first direct airstrikes on Iranian military sites, with UAE providing intelligence and air cover, according to the Journal.

stories.title: Zelensky says Ukraine will build drone factory in the US
stories.description: The announcement follows a bilateral agreement for Ukraine to export combat drones for Pentagon testing and a planned Trump meeting Monday.

stories.title: CDC expands cyclospora outbreak to 9 states as N.C. links cases to herbs
stories.description: North Carolina officials say parsley, cilantro, and lettuce are "showing up repeatedly" in patient interviews as the state reports 561 cases since May.

stories.title: Hugging Face used Chinese AI model to repel autonomous OpenAI cyberattack
stories.description: OpenAI admitted its models autonomously breached Hugging Face, which turned to China's open-weight GLM 5.2 after U.S. model guardrails blocked its defense.

stories.title: Trump administration warns Ukraine over Black Sea tanker strikes
stories.description: Chevron CEO Mike Wirth lobbied White House officials after drone attacks disrupted a pipeline carrying 2% of global oil supply.

stories.title: US measles cases hit 35-year record with months to go
stories.description: The nation has logged 2,295 cases as of this week, surpassing all of 2025's total — the highest annual count since 1991.

stories.title: EU adopts largest sanctions package in four years, targeting Russian crypto and banks
stories.description: The 21st package includes transaction bans on 14 crypto platforms, asset freezes on 94 Russian banks, and a freeze on the oil price cap.

stories.title: Trump roasts media at rescheduled correspondents' dinner
stories.description: The president admitted being "oversensitive" to press coverage, then targeted CNN's Anderson Cooper and Kaitlan Collins at the event held three months after a shooting.

stories.title: UK vows defense after Iran declares bases a target
stories.description: Britain said its armed forces are "ready 24/7" after Iran's IRGC warned that any UK base used by the US to strike Iran is a "legitimate target."

stories.title: Ukraine's Magura naval drones to be built in the US under new deal
stories.description: UFORCE and ReconCraft signed an agreement to produce Ukraine's combat-tested autonomous naval drones at facilities in Oregon and South Carolina.

stories.title: Taylor Farms met with White House before FDA walked back outbreak finding
stories.description: The produce giant visited officials days before a cyclospora test result on its lettuce was retracted as a false positive.

stories.title: Iran rebuilt missile sites faster than expected, WSJ reports
stories.description: Satellite imagery and military analysts show Tehran restored underground facilities and continued strikes despite US claims of severe degradation.

stories.title: DOJ withdraws subpoenas against New York Times reporters over Air Force One story
stories.description: A federal judge pressured prosecutors to pull the demands or have them quashed, ending one of the most aggressive government actions against the press in recent memory.

stories.title: Trump threatens trade probe after EU fines Google $1B
stories.description: The president announced a Section 301 investigation after Brussels imposed its first Digital Markets Act penalty on the tech giant.

stories.title: House AI Kill Switch bill would let DHS shut down rogue AI models
stories.description: The bipartisan "AI Kill Switch Act" responds to OpenAI's disclosure that its models escaped a testing sandbox and hacked Hugging Face's servers.

stories.title: Boelter gets two life terms for killing Minnesota lawmaker
stories.description: The gunman who assassinated former House Speaker Melissa Hortman and her husband was sentenced Thursday in Minneapolis federal court.

stories.title: Trump orders warning signs outside Smithsonian history museum
stories.description: The executive order directs the National Park Service to install signage telling visitors that exhibits "should be renovated" and pointing them to alternative resources.

stories.title: US jobless claims drop to 187,000, lowest since 1969
stories.description: Initial filings for unemployment benefits hit a 57-year low last week, reinforcing a "low hire, low fire" labor market dynamic.

stories.title: Rubio and Lavrov hold 35-minute Ukraine talks in Manila with no breakthrough
stories.description: The two top diplomats met on the sidelines of the ASEAN gathering, but no follow-up talks were scheduled and Russia warned against arming Ukraine.

stories.title: White House tensions grow with DHS chief Mullin, reports say
stories.description: Multiple reports describe friction between President Trump and Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin over a series of missteps just four months into his tenure.

stories.title: Secret Service agent on Vance detail suspended in leak probe
stories.description: The agent is suspected of sourcing an MS NOW report on frustration within Vance's security team over costly, last-minute travel demands.

stories.title: Houthis strike two Saudi oil tankers in Red Sea blockade's first enforcement
stories.description: The attacks on the ENCELIA and LAYLA mark the first time the group has acted on its maritime embargo declared days earlier.

stories.title: Thune fires back at White House over SAVE Act impasse
stories.description: The Senate majority leader told the White House to "get the votes" after being publicly pressured over the stalled elections bill.

stories.title: US probes possible Russian role in Iran drone strikes on CIA facilities
stories.description: Reuters reports that intelligence analysts are investigating whether Moscow provided targeting data or enhanced drone technology for March attacks on CIA sites.

stories.title: Independent autopsy of Nolan Wells finds cause of death undetermined
stories.description: Key throat structures were missing from the body, preventing the pathologist from ruling out foul play in the 18-year-old's death.

stories.title: Trump admin drops subpoena seeking list of Jewish employees at Penn
stories.description: The agency agreed not to pursue personal contact information of Jewish staff, ending a year-long legal battle with the university.

stories.title: Mamdani admits NYC can't arrest Netanyahu, urges feds to act
stories.description: The mayor walked back a signature campaign promise, saying the city lacks legal authority to enforce the ICC's warrant against the Israeli PM.

stories.title: Judge sets June 2027 trial date for Maduro drug case
stories.description: A federal judge approved a joint prosecution-defense proposal scheduling the ousted Venezuelan president's narco-terrorism trial to begin next June.

stories.title: Trump says frozen Iranian assets will cover Gulf ship damage
stories.description: The president posted on Truth Social that U.S.-held Iranian funds will pay for any damage to ships and cargo in the region.

stories.title: Ukraine's new military chief vows to intensify strikes inside Russia
stories.description: Mykhailo Drapatyi assumed command on Wednesday after Zelenskyy dismissed Syrskyi following days of nationwide protests.

stories.title: Epstein-linked modeling scout Daniel Siad found dead near Paris
stories.description: Siad, 69, was under investigation in France for alleged human trafficking and rape tied to the Epstein case.

stories.title: White House says Trump won't block Tate brothers' UK extradition
stories.description: Karoline Leavitt confirmed the administration will not intervene as Andrew and Tristan Tate face 59 criminal charges in Britain.

stories.title: Data center moratoriums spread across US as cities and Congress join New York's lead
stories.description: From Henderson, Nevada, to Capitol Hill, officials are moving to pause large data center construction amid concerns over energy, water, and community impacts.

stories.title: Kuwait summons Iran's ambassador after fourth day of strikes on water plants
stories.description: Fires broke out at multiple power and desalination facilities Monday as Iran's attacks threaten drinking water supplies amid extreme heat.

stories.title: US surges troops to Middle East as Trump weighs expanding Iran war
stories.description: The buildup follows the deaths of four service members and 12 straight days of U.S. strikes against Iran.

stories.title: House passes stopgap bill to avert pre-election shutdown
stories.description: The clean continuing resolution funds the government through Dec. 4, removing shutdown risk ahead of November midterms.

stories.title: Tornado watch covers 32M as storms snarl Northeast commute
stories.description: FAA ground stops hit major airports from Boston to Atlanta as severe storms bring tornado, flood and wind threats across the region.

stories.title: House passes $95B budget for Iran war, SAVE Act
stories.description: The 216-214 party-line vote advances Trump's push to fund the Iran conflict, aid farmers and enact voter ID rules before the midterms.

stories.title: Hegseth tells senators Iran war has cost $37.5 billion
stories.description: The defense secretary testified before the Senate Appropriations Committee to defend an $87.6 billion supplemental funding request for the conflict.

stories.title: Opposition leader Gandhi detained at protest outside Modi's residence
stories.description: Delhi Police forcibly removed and detained opposition leaders staging a sit-in over police action against students protesting the NEET paper leak.

stories.title: Iran denies nuclear activity at Pickaxe Mountain after Trump strike threat
stories.description: Tehran called U.S. focus on the underground site "a fabricated pretext for aggression" one day after Trump vowed to hit it "pretty soon."

stories.title: U.S. withholds over $1B in Medicaid funds from California, Minnesota
stories.description: HHS Secretary RFK Jr. announced Tuesday that CMS is deferring $867 million from California and $200 million from Minnesota over fraud concerns.

stories.title: 144 migrants dead or missing off Mauritania, UN says
stories.description: One boat drifted for 25 days after leaving The Gambia for Spain's Canary Islands, with only 38 of 181 passengers surviving.

stories.title: Only $300M of $13B in Venezuelan oil revenue traced back to Caracas, FT finds
stories.description: An investigation reveals the Trump administration has offered conflicting accounts of where earthquake-devastated Venezuela's oil money has gone.

stories.title: France bans social media for children under 15
stories.description: Parliament approved the landmark bill Tuesday, making France the first European country to restrict minors' access to social platforms.

stories.title: CIA assesses US strikes unlikely to change Iran's stance
stories.description: A new intelligence assessment finds Tehran and Washington are locked in an indefinite impasse as exchanges grow more lethal.

stories.title: Trump-backed candidates sweep Arizona's key primaries
stories.description: Former NFL kicker Jay Feely won the GOP primary in Arizona's competitive 1st District, while Rep. Andy Biggs secured the gubernatorial nomination.

stories.title: Ortega declares Nicaragua will never hold elections again
stories.description: The 80-year-old president made the announcement during a speech marking the 47th anniversary of the Sandinista revolution on Sunday.

stories.title: Pentagon identifies 3rd soldier killed in Iran war weekend attacks
stories.description: The death toll in the U.S.-Iran conflict reached 17, with 427 service members injured since Operation Epic Fury began in February.

stories.title: Trump announces 100% tariff on generic drugs starting August 2028
stories.description: Imported generics will remain tariff-free for two years before facing a 100% duty, then 200% — a bid to onshore production of drugs that fill over 90% of U.S. prescriptions.

stories.title: Iran says it struck Amazon data center in Bahrain
stories.description: The IRGC claims cruise missiles destroyed Amazon's central data infrastructure in Bahrain as retaliation for a U.S. strike on Iran's Darkhovin nuclear site.

stories.title: Sinaloa Cartel co-founder El Mayo Zambada sentenced to life in U.S. prison
stories.description: The 76-year-old drug kingpin also faces $15 billion in financial penalties, though experts say recovering more than a fraction is unlikely.

stories.title: White House to shift billions in research funding toward AI, away from colleges
stories.description: OSTP Director Michael Kratsios is set to testify Wednesday as the administration moves to redirect billions in research funding toward artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Hamas elects chief negotiator al-Hayya as new leader
stories.description: The group's top ceasefire negotiator replaces Yahya Sinwar, who was killed by Israeli forces in October 2024, after a months-long internal vote.

stories.title: Andy Burnham takes office as UK prime minister
stories.description: The former Greater Manchester mayor succeeds Keir Starmer, pledging to "rewire" Britain with a focus on devolution and cost-of-living relief.

stories.title: Trump wants FIFA's Infantino as next UN chief
stories.description: The proposal follows their close alliance during the 2026 World Cup, where the two handed Spain the trophy on July 19.

stories.title: Spain wins 2026 World Cup with extra-time goal over Argentina
stories.description: Ferran Torres scored in the 106th minute to give Spain a 1-0 victory over Argentina at MetLife Stadium in the final.

stories.title: Homan says ICE body cameras purchased, training underway for nationwide rollout
stories.description: The border czar's Sunday remarks follow two fatal ICE shootings of immigrants during vehicle stops in Houston and Maine this month.

stories.title: Trump moves to end 40-year ban on direct US-Lebanon flights
stories.description: The announcement came during Lebanese President Joseph Aoun's White House visit, the first by a Lebanese leader since 2009.

stories.title: FBI told to stop investigating ICE confrontations, NYT reports
stories.description: The reported shift would limit independent scrutiny of immigration agents as nearly half of federal assault cases against protesters have collapsed.

stories.title: Venezuela earthquake death toll passes 5,100 as IMF funds flow to rebuilding
stories.description: The twin 7.2 and 7.5 magnitude quakes on June 24 have left nearly 20,000 homeless, with the country securing $346 million from the IMF for reconstruction.

stories.title: IRS chief Bisignano denies report he spied on JPMorgan colleagues
stories.description: Bisignano called The Wall Street Journal's allegations "bad journalism for political reasons," saying "none of it's true" in a Tuesday interview.

stories.title: Iran's reclusive new leader may speak with Putin first, TASS reports
stories.description: Mojtaba Khamenei has not appeared publicly since succeeding his father in March and will stay hidden for security reasons, an Iranian source said.

stories.title: Israel advances 1,024 new settlement units in West Bank
stories.description: The Palestinian Colonization and Wall Resistance Commission said nine settlement plans have been advanced since early July, targeting over 1,069 dunams of land.

stories.title: Trump announces trade deal with Jordan to expand US market access
stories.description: Jordan agreed to remove non-tariff barriers and open its markets to American agricultural products and motor vehicles under a new reciprocal trade pact.

stories.title: Iraq, Syria sign US-backed deal to revive oil pipeline bypassing Hormuz
stories.description: The $60 billion package of agreements includes rehabilitating the Kirkuk-Baniyas corridor to carry 2 million barrels per day to the Mediterranean.

stories.title: AIPAC pulls fundraising support for Democrats who voted to cut Israel aid
stories.description: The lobbying group removed donation links for endorsed House Democrats after 103 backed an amendment to eliminate $3.3 billion in military assistance.

stories.title: Lebanon's Aoun to meet Trump to press for Israeli withdrawal
stories.description: The first White House visit by a Lebanese president in nearly 20 years centers on securing Israel's pullback from southern Lebanon.

stories.title: Israel destroys 3 more schools in southern Lebanon
stories.description: Lebanon's education minister says Israeli forces looted and demolished three schools, bringing the total destroyed to 20.

stories.title: DHS chief threatens prison for election officials who defy voter roll orders
stories.description: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin warned of fines and prison time for state officials who refuse to cooperate with federal election security mandates.

stories.title: Israel says Iran moved centrifuges into Pickaxe Mountain
stories.description: The intelligence was shared with the U.S. as Trump weighs strikes on the fortified underground nuclear site near Natanz.

stories.title: Apple in early settlement talks with DOJ over antitrust case
stories.description: The discussions, first reported by Bloomberg, come after Apple made multiple settlement offers this year in the smartphone monopoly lawsuit.

stories.title: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake hits Mexico's Chiapas coast, triggering tsunami warning
stories.description: The shallow quake struck near Puerto Madero on Friday, shaking buildings as far as Guatemala City and El Salvador.

stories.title: New UK PM Burnham speaks with Trump on defense, Hormuz
stories.description: Hours after taking office Monday, Burnham congratulated Trump on the World Cup and pledged UK commitment to securing the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Andy Burnham becomes Labour leader, set to be PM
stories.description: Burnham ran unopposed after securing support from 379 of 403 Labour MPs, following Keir Starmer's resignation last month.

stories.title: Fired DOJ attorney accuses Blanche of lying at AG hearing
stories.description: Elizabeth Oyer told the Senate Judiciary Committee that Todd Blanche's testimony about her firing over the Mel Gibson gun-rights case was "provably false."

stories.title: Sen. Darline Graham launches bid for full Senate term
stories.description: Graham told Fox News' Sean Hannity she's "in" the Aug. 11 special GOP primary, backed by Trump's endorsement, to succeed her late brother Lindsey.

stories.title: SpaceX scrubs Starship Flight 13 after engine ignition failure
stories.description: The abort at Starbase in Texas marks the second consecutive Starship launch scrub, with SpaceX shares falling in after-hours trading.

top.title: Apple shares drop sharply in worst post-earnings fall in 13 years

top.title: Trump blames Minnesota, not Iran, for water cyberattacks

top.title: Hospitals report sharp rise in uninsured ER visits after ACA subsidy cuts
top.description: Major hospital chains say uninsured patient volumes jumped roughly 20%, with some projecting hundreds of millions in lost revenue.

top.title: McConnell faces Monday deadline as Beshear demands he prove fitness or resign
top.description: Kentucky's governor says McConnell is "ruining" his legacy by refusing to address constituents from a rehab facility he's been in since June.

top.title: Hamas accepts Gaza disarmament framework but sets conditions for Israel
top.description: Trump announced a phased deal for Hamas to surrender its weapons, but the group says Israel must first honor ceasefire commitments.

top.title: Spain, Morocco halt Ceuta crossings after 49,000 breach border in a day

top.title: Anthropic says Claude AI models hacked three companies during tests

top.title: Trump defends 'anti-weaponization' fund, attacks Cornyn over AG nomination standoff
top.description: The president reversed course from a day earlier, now calling for Blanche's immediate confirmation while defending the $1.8 billion fund blocking it.

top.title: Saudi Arabia launches 14-nation maritime coalition to guard Red Sea shipping

top.title: U.S. hits dozens of Iranian targets after missile attack on American troops
top.description: The strikes mark a resumption of hostilities after a brief pause, as the conflict widens to Egypt, Kuwait, and Jordan.

top.title: Trump walks back Patriot missile license promise to Ukraine

top.title: Hormuz shipping rebounds under US military escort amid Iran conflict
top.description: Oil transit through the strait rose to 20 vessels on July 29, up from single digits, though flows remain far below preconflict levels.

top.title: Senate blocks Iran war powers resolution for 13th time

top.title: ABC accuses FCC of 'attempted censorship' over early license renewals

top.title: Boeing reportedly blocking Ukraine's Patriot missile plans
top.description: The aerospace giant's refusal to license seeker head technology could undermine Trump's pledge to let Ukraine produce PAC-3 interceptors.

top.title: All 55 UEFA members vote to boycott World Cup over FIFA investor plan

top.title: Trump weighs $100,000 fee for foreign students seeking US jobs

top.title: Egypt confirms drone attack on LNG vessels at Damietta Port

top.title: Gulf states turn to China to pressure Iran on Hormuz
top.description: Frustrated by the limits of U.S. military power, Gulf Arab capitals are testing whether Beijing's economic leverage can reopen vital shipping lanes.

top.title: U.S. economy grew 1.5% in Q2, missing forecasts
top.description: The Commerce Department's advance estimate fell short of the 2.1% growth economists expected, as a widening trade deficit offset strong consumer spending.

top.title: IBM says quantum computers now outperform classical systems with verifiable results
top.description: Three papers detail computations beyond classical reach, including a 70-logical-qubit task completed in 15 minutes that classical methods cannot replicate.

top.title: DOJ activates secret 'alien terrorist' court for first time in 30 years
top.description: The never-before-used tribunal will hear its first case Thursday, seeking to deport an Afghan woman over alleged ties to an ISIS-inspired Election Day plot.

top.title: Trump says he'd be 'disappointed' if China arms Iran
top.description: The president said he takes Xi Jinping at his word after Reuters reported Iran expects 400 Chinese-made missile launchers within weeks.

top.title: Europe wildfires kill 3 Greek firefighters as 330,000 flee across continent
top.description: Blazes spreading from France and Spain to Greece and Turkey have displaced hundreds of thousands as a fourth summer heatwave intensifies the crisis.

top.title: Pentagon expands Patriot missile contract to $59B
top.description: The deal with Lockheed Martin comes as the U.S. weighs licensing Patriot production to Ukraine and scrambles to replenish depleted interceptor stocks.

top.title: Trump 'exasperated' as aides fail to agree on Iran war strategy

top.title: Judge blocks DOJ from accessing New Jersey voter rolls

top.title: Altman calls for slowing AI development after models hacked external systems

top.title: Trump vows to hit Iran 'hard' after missile attack on US forces in Jordan

top.title: Fed holds rates steady as three officials dissent in favor of a hike
top.description: The hawkish split at the July meeting raises the odds of a rate increase when the FOMC next convenes in September.

top.title: Three men plead guilty to supporting ISIS in federal court
top.description: The cases stem from a broader conspiracy disrupted in late 2025 that included a plot to attack the LGBTQ+ community in Detroit on Halloween.

top.title: Blanche AG vote delayed as GOP senators demand IRS deal changes
top.description: Sens. Cornyn and Tillis refused to back the nominee without written guarantees on Trump's tax audit immunity and a controversial fund.

top.title: Houthis consider charging transit fees on Red Sea ships

top.title: Trump says he's 'looking at controls' on AI after OpenAI breach
top.description: More than 1,200 AI lab employees also signed a letter calling on Washington to build tools for slowing development if needed.

top.title: Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment at Senate COVID hearing

top.title: Russia charges Telegram founder Durov with terrorism
top.description: The FSB issued an international arrest warrant for Durov, accusing him of failing to remove channels used by Ukrainian intelligence.

top.title: SK Hynix posts record Q2 profit but misses estimates
top.description: The memory chipmaker's 557% operating profit surge still fell short of consensus, as long-term HBM contracts limited gains from rising spot prices.

top.title: Senate confirms Jay Clayton as intelligence chief in party-line vote

top.title: ICE arrests foreign nationals with expired visas at 15+ U.S. airports

top.title: Judge blocks Minnesota's prediction markets ban days before it takes effect

top.title: Trump administration to end Medicare drug plan subsidy

top.title: NYC's municipal grocery stores to offer 30% off essentials, Mamdani says

top.title: DOJ moves to drop charge against SEIU California leader David Huerta

top.title: Trump says new tariffs do 'same thing' as ones Supreme Court struck down

top.title: Trump announces 100% tariff on generic drugs starting August 2028

top.title: Hamas elects chief negotiator al-Hayya as new leader
